copy.fb:
The Epsonics opened their Brisbane set with this early 2000s banger.
Full song: https://www.battleofthetechbands.com/go/E2yeRiHRUlw/fb-caption

Epsilon's band donned their best business attire, to rock out with this version of Queens of the Stone Age's "No One Knows" at The Triffid. Highest judges' score of the night, second overall.

Video shot by Aaron Griffiths and Kurt Boldy. Live audio by Nick Forrester.

Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive. All proceeds to Youngcare, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
